suggested_tests.code:
import re

from hypothesis import assume, example, given, strategies as st

from ledger.accounts.emailcheck import validate_email

VENDOR_LOCAL_PART = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+")
MULTI_LABEL_DOMAINS = st.from_regex(r"[a-z0-9]{1,10}(\.[a-z0-9]{1,10}){1,2}\.[a-z]{2,6}", fullmatch=True)


@given(st.emails(domains=MULTI_LABEL_DOMAINS))
@example("bob@eng.acme.com")
def test_validate_email_returns_multi_label_domain(email):
    local, _, domain = email.rpartition("@")
    assume(VENDOR_LOCAL_PART.fullmatch(local))
    assert validate_email(email) == domain.lower()
